review_candidates.title: Unix Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description As a Unix Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, and advanced troubleshooting of critical Unix/Linux environments, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous availability of AIX, RHEL, and Debian platforms across on‑premises and cloud‑adjacent infrastructures. Responsibilities Administer and troubleshoot complex Unix/Linux environments (AIX, RHEL, Debian); Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Unix/Linux systems and related component
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications 5–10 years of experience in Unix/Linux administration in enterprise environments; Strong expertise in IBM AIX, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and Debian; Deep knowledge of Unix/Linux internals: boot process, services, package management, filesystems, LVM, multipath, networking, logging, and performance troubleshooting; Hands‑on experience with high‑availability clustering (Serviceguard, Bull ARF, Pacemaker/Corosync); Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, ksh, Python, Ansible); Solid understanding of security, hardening, permissions, PAM/SSH, audit frameworks, and compliance; Familiarity with network protocols and services (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NTP); Experience with VMware or equivalent virtualization platforms; Cloud knowledge (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus; Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Icinga, ScienceLogic, syslog, SNMP); Relevant certification
